profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit organization operating at khanacademy.org. The company's own website returned only a client challenge page during harvesting, so substantive detail about its programs and mission is not available from that source.

The held facts show that Khan Academy offers an AI product called Khanmigo, categorized as an educational AI tutor. The product is noted in connection with student interaction data, COPPA compliance considerations, and pedagogical bias as areas of relevance. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the organization.
